projects.title: Pixel Platformer
projects.description: A browser-based platformer game built with JavaScript and HTML5 Canvas. Experience classic gaming mechanics with smooth animations, multiple levels, and responsive controls. Perfect for both casual players and retro gaming enthusiasts.

projects.title: Math Visuals Collection
projects.description: Interactive mathematical visualizations including differentials, integrals, Fourier transforms, and Laplace transforms. Perfect for learning and exploring mathematical concepts.

projects.title: Mini Games Collection
projects.description: All kinds of games like Snake, Tic-Tac-Toe, Chess, and many more games to come. A growing collection of web-based entertainment.

projects.title: Drinking Simulator
projects.description: A fun party simulation game with interactive elements and themed music. Perfect for social gatherings and entertainment with friends.

projects.title: Tree Website
projects.description: An interactive visualization of trees and nature with beautiful biome styling. Experience different environmental themes and natural landscapes.

projects.title: Voice to Text
projects.description: Real-time speech recognition tool that converts your voice to text with enhanced accuracy. Perfect for transcription, note-taking, and accessibility.
